snippet.title: Cronos: The New Dawn | A New Breed Of Horror
snippet.description:
Even in a world full of terrors, you may encounter creatures willing to aid you in your struggle for survival. Watch the Brand New Trailer for Cronos: The New Dawn that premiered on Gamescom's Opening Night Live and see if you can spot them 

The game will arrive on September 5 to PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S and Nintendo Switch 2! Pre-order or Wishlist Cronos: The New Dawn! https://cronosnewdawn.com/

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2101960/Cronos_The_New_Dawn/
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10011556
Xbox: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9p7tflq7ctxn
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/cronos-the-new-dawn-85b409

“Sixteen Days/Gathering Dust” Performed by This Mortal Coil
Written & Produced by Richard Ian Brown, Michael Francis Conroy, Robbie Grey, Gary Francis McDowell, Stephen James Walker Licensed courtesy of 4AD Ltd / Beggars Group Media / Universal Music Publishing / Mesh & Lace Music
